question: Can a relational stage-two context exclude reversal, vertical repricing and persistently loose paths before any local VCP contraction is evaluated?
scope: Semantic representation only. It reads raw causal bars from broad-candidate dates but does not reuse the broad detector's legs, pivot, score or outcomes.

fixed_method.context: Exclude the completed signal bar, use the preceding 150 bars, and split them into three equal chronological blocks.
fixed_method.prior_advance: The middle-block median close must exceed the early-block median close.
fixed_method.gain_retention: The late-block median must remain above the early-block median, and its minimum close must remain above the midpoint between the early median and the pre-signal high.
fixed_method.continuous_advance: The three largest positive daily log returns combined must contribute less than all remaining positive daily returns combined, so a few repricing bars cannot define the trend.
fixed_method.settling: Median daily high-low range relative to close must be lower in the late block than in the middle block.
fixed_method.demand: The completed signal bar must close above the preceding 20-bar high, in the upper half of its own range, on volume above the preceding 20-bar median.
fixed_method.supported: All five relational conditions hold. No score or tunable neighborhood is used.

fresh_blind_packet.exclusions: All 88 cases from the three earlier semantic packets are excluded.
fresh_blind_packet.selection: Ascending SHA-256 of symbol, signal date, scale and sealed status; future outcomes are not part of selection.

stop_rule: If any gate fails, stop this context representation and do not vary block size, gain-retention boundary, concentration rule, range comparison or demand rule on exposed samples.
next_if_pass: Combine this frozen context with a separately defined local contraction representation, then validate the combined v3 semantics on another fresh packet before any time-split return diagnostic.
next_if_fail: Stop price-path context engineering and retain human-visible semantic review as a research aid while moving the v3 hypothesis to a different causal input.
